scope: Focused triage of the 66 failures observed after the accepted Canvas composition refinement. Each case was investigated; product regressions were fixed by UI owners, while obsolete markup or synthetic-event assumptions were adapted without dropping business assertions. These focused results do not replace the ordered full repository verifier.
